blurb: Meetings, negotiation, finance and management — the register of work.

fields.name: Meetings & Process
fields.note: How work is organised and talked about: agendas, escalation, the words that move a decision along.

fields.name: Negotiation & Persuasion
fields.note: Getting to terms — leverage, concession, and the careful language of not quite agreeing yet.

fields.name: Finance & Risk
fields.note: Money, exposure and what might go wrong: the vocabulary of budgets, runway and liability.

fields.name: Strategy & Positioning
fields.note: Where a business says it stands and why — markets, moats, and the language of intent.

fields.name: People & Management
fields.note: Hiring, reviewing, delegating and letting go: what is said about people at work, and how carefully.

fields.name: Law & Obligation
fields.note: Contracts and what they bind you to — indemnity, breach, and the words that carry consequences.
